card.name: Inside long medical terms
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of long medical words that are still unfinished, such as the 'ad' in bradycardia, 'io' in angioedema, 'acid' in ketoacidosis and 'ophil' in Haemophilus.

modes.label: Heart and swelling terms
modes.description: Middle piece of bradycardia or angioedema, where the rest of the word must follow.

modes.label: Other long terms
modes.description: Middle piece of other long clinical or drug names such as Haemophilus, ketoacidosis, tetrabenazine and dextrose.
